# Plan (opus, strong)

## Goal

Today `determinize` guesses every hidden card from one set of seen cards: the ones the opponent has shown. After the fix it keeps one seen set and one already-sampled set per side. The opponent's hidden cards are sampled exactly as today. Hidden cards in the seat's own library are sampled against what the seat's side shows, so a world never holds a second copy of a card the seat already shows (§2.6). Two cases in that library:
- A card minted for the opponent's deck (R73, a library that Pocket Chaos swapped) still belongs to the opponent's side.
- Any other hidden card there (a dealt deck under R433, a library swapped back, a card Transmogulate put there) is the seat's own. It may take a card id that only the opponent has shown.

The rng draws keep their number and order. Done means:
- the new tests pass;
- the existing determinize suites pass without edits;
- the AI gate holds its floors at smoke size;
- the new ruling R2826000 is written.

   /// and c{n1+1}..c{n1+n2} for p2's (R184's deck sizes).
   pub(crate) fn minted_for_deck_of(state: &GameState, player: PlayerId, card: &CardInstance) -> bool {
       let n1 = f64::from(handicap_of(&state.players.p1).deck_size);
       let n2 = f64::from(handicap_of(&state.players.p2).deck_size);
       let (low, high) = if player == PlayerId::P1 { (1.0, n1) } else { (n1 + 1.0, n1 + n2) };

   }
